name: Regenerative Strength (#197 P12): the Volley Squad shoots the Pain Fueled Beast, whose Regeneration ignores a FRACTION of the wounds under the probabilistic roller - and banks an equal fraction of a marker. The Beast (already activated in round 1, so the shooting lands first) then charges in round 2, where exactly one of its two melee weapons gets +X attacks on the player's say-so. Watch for: 'banks N Regenerative Strength marker(s)', then one offer, then an attack count above the weapon's printed A-value.
